actions.command:
echo "=== OS ===" && cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -5
echo "=== systemd ===" && systemctl --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo "no systemd"
echo "=== ports ===" && (ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null)
echo "=== python/node/go ===" && which python3 node go gcc cc 2>/dev/null
echo "=== existing job dirs ===" 
find / -xdev -iname "*job*" -not -path "*/proc/*" -not -path "/root/.local/share/claux/*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E '^/(usr|lib|sys)' | head -100
